rule: GOAL: Place colored blocks into four target slots to match a top pattern. CONTROLS: Click a block to select it, then click a target slot to place it. RULE: Placing a block swaps it with whatever was in that slot, moving the old item back to the source. TRAP: Assuming empty slots stay empty; they actually hold invisible or gray tokens that swap back to your hand.

GOAL: Align the yellow plug on the key with the yellow socket in the black bar. CONTROLS: Clicking the lower blue region shifts the bottom boundary and the attached key to the left. RULE: The key moves exactly four columns for each click, keeping its offset from the boundary constant. TRAP: Thinking the key stays fixed; ignoring that it is attached to the moving lower edge caused misalignment.

GOAL: Reach the exit in sixteen moves. CONTROLS: Arrow keys slide you until you hit a wall or a solid white tile. RULE: You cannot stop on gray ice; you slide through it until hitting a stopping point. TRAP: Believing you stop at the first tile you touch, rather than sliding through ice until a hard stop.

GOAL: Move the purple token to the blue target. CONTROLS: Click a node to shift the purple token toward it. RULE: The purple token moves a maximum of three steps per click. TRAP: Assuming you could move any distance in one click wastes actions.

GOAL: Push blocks into matching colored slots to clear the grid. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move your character; Space picks up or drops held blocks. RULE: You can only carry one block at a time, but it moves with you. TRAP: Assuming you can drop a block while still carrying it or without facing the target spot.

GOAL: Align the key's gap with the lower bar by expanding the bottom section. CONTROLS: Top buttons shrink the middle section; bottom buttons expand the bottom section. RULE: The key must sit exactly within the white space of the bottom band to fit. TRAP: Clicking bottom buttons blindly fails if the middle section lacks space to shrink.

GOAL: Drop the ball into a side notch. CONTROLS: Arrows move the paddle; space launches the ball. RULE: Bounce angle changes based on where the ball hits the paddle. TRAP: Launching without aiming sends the ball straight down into a fail zone.

GOAL: Rotate glyphs in a cycle to match target patterns. CONTROLS: Arrows rotate the current glyph; Right/Left moves between slots. RULE: Glyphs cycle through fixed poses; exact visual matching confirms success. TRAP: Assuming recorded cycle poses were accurate without verifying the actual current glyph state.

GOAL: Drain the left bands to fill the right ones, matching the target liquid levels exactly. CONTROLS: Click the blue buttons at the bottom to push liquid over the bars, moving it two units at a time. RULE: Liquid only flows when the source level is high enough to spill over the barrier’s top edge. TRAP: Assuming you can move liquid freely regardless of height. Forcing a transfer when levels are too low wastes moves.

GOAL: Place seven colored items into specific target slots to match a hidden sequence. CONTROLS: Click palette items to select, click slots to place, press space to submit. RULE: Items are read left-to-right: two reds, four greens, then the final red item. TRAP: Assuming the last red item appears earlier in the sequence or that empty slots are skipped.

GOAL: Grow two small tokens into a large one and guide it to the target zone. CONTROLS: Click near a token to move it one step in that direction. RULE: Two tokens of the same size merge into a larger token when they touch. TRAP: Moving tokens far apart to "plan ahead" wastes moves; always keep them close to trigger merges instantly.

GOAL: Align letters with panels below handles. CONTROLS: Click palette then slot; Space confirms. RULE: Read order follows left-to-right, nesting panel contents under their parent handle. TRAP: Assuming panels sit directly under the main panel; they align only with their specific handle's column.

GOAL: Move the inchworm head into the cup. CONTROLS: Arrows shift or rotate the worm; click keypad cells to match the pattern and trigger movement. RULE: The worm shrinks width when completing a pattern, allowing it to fit through the narrow rod. TRAP: Assuming left movement always works; the worm must be narrow to pass the thin section, so complete patterns to shrink before pressing left.

ESTABLISHED: The cable tip pushes or pulls blocks six columns when in contact. Blocks stop at walls or other blocks. The block detaches when the tip passes its left edge. FAILED: Fully retracting the cable did not drag the block to the far left; it stuck at the wall. GOAL IS NOT: Simply extending the cable to maximum length to move the block. CONTROLS: UP and DOWN shift the cable row. LEFT and RIGHT move the tip six columns, dragging any touching block in the same direction.

GOAL: Arrange seven tokens to reveal a hidden target sequence. CONTROLS: Click a palette token to select it, then click a panel slot to place it. RULE: The handle acts as a break, forcing the middle three tokens onto the separate green panel. TRAP: Assuming the handle can be moved after placement, locking you into the wrong split.

GOAL: Lift the wide tip into the cup. CONTROLS: Arrows move the tip vertically. RULE: Keypad patterns teleport the tip to yellow checkpoints. TRAP: Thinking the narrow constriction blocked the vertical path.

GOAL: Arrange tokens to form a specific nine-character sequence. CONTROLS: Drag tokens to slots; press space to check. RULE: Handles duplicate adjacent panel contents, allowing one set to fill multiple gaps. TRAP: Assuming each slot holds only one token; handles actually expand the sequence.

GOAL: Match four bottom pink glyphs to their correct rule pairs using 30 arrow moves. CONTROLS: Arrows shift the active selection to align pink patterns with rule slots. RULE: Each pink glyph uniquely transforms to match exactly one yellow output pattern. TRAP: Assuming all pink glyphs were identical size; varying heights broke the matching logic.

GOAL: Assemble a nine-item row by nesting three sub-panels into a master container. CONTROLS: Click palette tokens to fill empty sub-panel slots, then click sub-panel handles to stack them into the master row. RULE: The left-to-right order of handles in the master container determines the final sequence of the nested items. TRAP: Assuming the master row holds loose tokens directly; it strictly requires full sub-panels to function.

GOAL: Reach the exit without getting caught by the sliding creature. CONTROLS: Arrows make you slide until you hit a wall or obstacle. RULE: The creature only reacts if you are in its row, not its column. TRAP: Assuming vertical alignment was safe; stay out of the creature's horizontal line.

ESTABLISHED: The grid uses two rows, bars and stems, currently set to outer-only patterns. Two yellow shapes, a plug and a socket, define the target visual. FAILED: The current outer-only configuration for both rows does not clear the level. GOAL IS NOT: Simply matching the current state or guessing without aligning the rows to the specific top or bottom features of the yellow shapes. CONTROLS: Clicking individual cells toggles their color between black and white.

GOAL: Place both letter tokens completely inside their matching target shapes. CONTROLS: Clicking a destination moves the selected token directly to that spot. RULE: Tokens must be fully contained within the shape; partial overlap does not count. TRAP: Assuming any touch works; stopping early left the top edge outside the boundary.

GOAL: Find the hidden rotation that aligns input glyphs to rules, then apply it to the output glyphs. CONTROLS: Arrows adjust the rotation of the selected glyph group. RULE: Each matching group shares one rotation; the output length must equal the target count. TRAP: Assuming rotations are fixed or independent; they must be uniform per group but vary between groups.

GOAL: Extend colored bars until their dots land exactly on matching plus signs. CONTROLS: Clicking a bar’s top tile shrinks it; clicking the bottom tile grows it. RULE: Growth adds three pixels per click, so align the tip to the target center. TRAP: Assuming the bar passes through the target; it stops when the dot hits the center.

GOAL: Match seven blue target shapes to their correct cycle positions using canonical rotation classes. CONTROLS: Arrow keys navigate the cursor and rotate the active glyph to align shapes. RULE: The game validates by shape identity, ignoring specific rotations, so any pose of the correct shape counts. TRAP: Assuming exact pose matching is required, which wastes actions rotating to a specific orientation instead of just the right shape.

GOAL: Set both rows to all black to form a solid rectangle. CONTROLS: Clicking a bar or stem toggles its specific column color. RULE: A filled plug and socket combine to create a completely solid shape. TRAP: Assuming the goal was empty space or mixed gray patterns, rather than full saturation.

GOAL: Align yellow and blue crosses to cover their respective dots. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected cross; Space switches between crosses. RULE: Crosses only cover dots of their own color, ignoring others. TRAP: Believing you must move one cross completely before touching the other; order doesn't matter, but switching early saves steps.

GOAL: Place the fifth box into the final empty slot to complete the level. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the player; Space places the held box. RULE: You must walk under the box, carry it to the target, then press Space to drop it. TRAP: Believing you could drop the box from a distance or without pressing Space caused wasted movement.

GOAL: Align moving shapes with their matching static targets. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected shape; Space cycles selection. RULE: Press Space repeatedly to identify which shape moves before acting. TRAP: Assuming the first selected shape was the one that needed moving.

GOAL: Rotate the outer ring to align specific colored blocks with fixed corner markers. CONTROLS: Left arrow shifts ring clockwise; right arrow shifts counter-clockwise; click blocks to inspect color. RULE: Relative order never changes; only cyclic position shifts, so match sequence gaps, not colors. TRAP: Assuming arrows toggle state; they rotate, so double-clicking same side wastes moves returning to start.

GOAL: Move the line, X, and diamond to cover two target boxes. CONTROLS: Arrows shift the selected shape three spaces; Space cycles selection. RULE: Shapes move in fixed three-space steps, so count presses by dividing distance by three. TRAP: Assuming moves are one space costs time; each press covers three, so halve your expected step count.

GOAL: Move the purple square into the dashed ring. CONTROLS: Clicking a dark spot moves the white head there, dragging the chain behind it. RULE: The purple body must land exactly on the target, not the head or tail. TRAP: Thinking the white head needs to reach the ring first; ignore the head’s position if it doesn’t pull the body into place.

GOAL: Change the target panel’s blue cells to red so its outer grid matches the small pattern shown inside it. CONTROLS: Click individual cells within the highlighted panel to toggle their color. RULE: The small inset pattern defines the correct final state; only the panel with mismatched outer and inner patterns needs fixing. TRAP: Clicking cells outside the highlighted target panel or assuming all panels need modification wastes moves and triggers failure.

GOAL: Place both green blocks into their matching holes. CONTROLS: Click to select a block; arrows move the selected block. RULE: Only the clicked block moves; others remain static obstacles. TRAP: Assuming unselected blocks push like boxes; they do not, so plan paths that avoid collisions.

GOAL: Match the grid to the mini map by painting specific cells orange. CONTROLS: Click grid cells to change their color. RULE: The mini map's center color indicates the target paint, overriding the previous red. TRAP: Assuming the paint color stays red from the first level wastes moves and fails the pattern.

GOAL: Merge the five scattered crosses into a single stack. CONTROLS: Clicking a cross selects it; clicking an empty spot moves the selection or triggers a merge. RULE: Crosses slide until blocked, combining into one piece when they collide. TRAP: Assuming crosses stop after one step; they actually slide all the way to the next obstacle.

GOAL: Guide two yellow blocks to their respective fixed target cursors. CONTROLS: Click arrows to rotate the central ring or shift horizontal rows. RULE: Blocks move with their current track; shared cells transfer blocks between ring and rows. TRAP: Assuming independent movement; rotating the ring shifts all blocks, potentially moving a block away from its target.

GOAL: Paint specific grid cells orange to match a hidden pattern. CONTROLS: Clicking a cell applies its center color to the surrounding 3x3 area. RULE: Gray marks in the clue mean "ignore," allowing overlaps without conflict. TRAP: Assuming gray means "must stay base" creates false conflicts and blocks the solution.

GOAL: Shift the entire chain three columns to the right to align the orange tip with the target zone. CONTROLS: Clicking the orange end pushed the whole structure right; clicking the blue end pulled it left. RULE: The chain moves as a single rigid unit; shifting one end translates the entire length without rotation. TRAP: Assuming the blue end was fixed, causing you to waste clicks trying to anchor it while the whole chain slid.

ESTABLISHED: Two blue blocks currently sit adjacent on the top bar, splitting the black region. The game does not allow blocks to overlap or pass through each other. FAILED: Attempts to merge blocks into a single stack or force them to cross sides produced no state change or level completion. GOAL IS NOT: Simply merging the blocks into one pile or swapping their left-right positions does not clear the level. CONTROLS: Directional inputs move blocks. Blocks block each other's path. Pressing direction towards another block causes a failed move, not a swap.

GOAL: Place both blocks on the top bar to split the black shape into two disconnected halves. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move both blocks simultaneously in the same direction. RULE: Blocks move as a single unit; they cannot pass through each other or overlap. TRAP: Trying to swap their positions or overlap them fails because they block each other.

GOAL: Rotate your glyph to match the target, then dock into the locked box. CONTROLS: Arrows move your sprite; standing on the pad rotates your current glyph. RULE: Docking only succeeds if your glyph matches the box’s lock exactly upon entry. TRAP: Assuming black tiles are walls; they are walkable, so hesitation cost valuable turns.

GOAL: Place the yellow block under the yellow cursor and the orange block under the orange cursor. CONTROLS: Red arrows rotate the ring counter-clockwise; green arrows rotate it clockwise. RULE: Match each block’s color to its corresponding target cursor position. TRAP: Assuming green arrows decrease ring indices when they actually increase them, causing wasted moves.

GOAL: Paint the board by clicking keys to set gray cells to their matching color. CONTROLS: Click keys to apply their color to gray squares in their windows. RULE: Gray squares take the color adjacent to the key's center in the legend. TRAP: Assuming gray follows the key's own color or base state wastes clicks.

GOAL: Cover every dot with a matching colored shape to clear the board. CONTROLS: Arrows move the current shape; Space switches between the cross and the plus. RULE: A dot is only solved if the shape covering it matches the dot's color. TRAP: Assuming covering dots is enough; leaving a shape mismatched keeps the level unsolved.

ESTABLISHED: SPACE teleports blue to the top-left and spawns a gray block that falls one cell per step until blocked. A second SPACE does not spawn a new gray block. FAILED: Pressing SPACE repeatedly to stack gray blocks or create obstacles failed; only the first spawn persists. GOAL IS NOT: Simply reaching the top-left corner, as the blue starts or returns there without clearing the level. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move blue one cell; SPACE teleports blue to the top-left and triggers the falling gray block.

GOAL: Move both blocks to the target without touching the red hazard zone. CONTROLS: Arrows move both blocks simultaneously in the chosen direction. RULE: If any part of a block’s new position overlaps red, the level resets. TRAP: Assuming you can dodge hazards by moving one block while the other stays; you cannot, so plan paths where both blocks land safely.

GOAL: Walk the blue block to the finish line. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the blue block; the spacebar fires a copy. RULE: The copy flies straight until it hits a wall or blocks a snake. TRAP: The copy does not stop at the target; it keeps going until blocked.

GOAL: Move three blocks into matching holes. CONTROLS: Arrows slide the selected block; clicks select a block. RULE: Blocks slide until hitting a wall or another block. TRAP: Assuming a block stops mid-path; it only stops when blocked, so plan for full slides.

GOAL: Rotate the pad twice to set the correct display, then reach the dock before the meter empties. CONTROLS: Arrows move the sprite; entering the pad rotates the display; arrows also navigate to the dock. RULE: Only entering the pad triggers rotation; leaving and re-entering allows multiple rotations from one spot. TRAP: Believing you need four moves to rotate twice; the initial arrival counts as the first entry.

GOAL: Move yellow and orange markers to their matching colored target slots on the grid. CONTROLS: Red arrows shift cycles backward; green arrows shift cycles forward horizontally or vertically. RULE: All arrows of the same color and direction perform identical global shifts, regardless of which cross they belong to. TRAP: Assuming each cross operates independently causes wasted clicks; remember that any green right arrow shifts the entire horizontal system together.

GOAL: Clear the level by satisfying spatial constraints through a minimal sequence of nine precise clicks. CONTROLS: Each click selected and moved one puzzle piece to a specific target coordinate. RULE: A piece could only be placed if its final position satisfied all overlapping geometric conditions simultaneously. TRAP: Assuming individual pieces could be adjusted independently after placement, rather than requiring perfect pre-planning.

GOAL: Move the charcoal block to cover the yellow target. CONTROLS: Arrow keys shift the block; SPACE wastes time without moving. RULE: The block moves in fixed three-pixel steps, not single pixels. TRAP: Thinking SPACE rotates or interacts; it only drains your action budget.

GOAL: Paint specific tiles purple without damaging key patterns. CONTROLS: Click tiles to toggle color; click brushes to toggle plus-shapes. RULE: Brushes affect neighbors, so verify key cells remain intact after each move. TRAP: Assuming brush clicks only affect the target tile; they toggle the cross, requiring extra clicks to fix collateral changes.

GOAL: Move both yellow blocks onto the marked target cells. CONTROLS: Left arrows rotate the full snake path forward; right arrows reverse it. Top arrows rotate only the top row independently. RULE: The snake acts as one long loop, while the top row forms a separate five-cell circle. TRAP: Assuming the top row moves with the snake. Treating them as linked cycles wastes moves; you must adjust the top row separately.

GOAL: Guide the black shape to its target by aligning it with its reflection. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected object; Space or click switches control between the shape and the mirror line. RULE: You must toggle control to move the shape vertically while the line stays fixed. TRAP: Trying to move the shape directly while the mirror line is selected wastes moves and fails.

GOAL: Arrange tokens and handles to link nested panels together. CONTROLS: Click to place items into slots; press Space to verify the solution. RULE: Handles connect panels vertically, with higher panels attaching to lower ones. TRAP: Assuming handles could connect upwards or that nesting order didn't matter.

GOAL: Place pieces on lower yellow shapes so their mirror images cover upper yellow shapes. CONTROLS: Arrows moved pieces; space rotated them. RULE: Symmetry only counted when both the piece and its reflection matched the yellow targets. TRAP: Assuming the reflection alone completed the level; ignoring the piece's position wasted many actions.

ESTABLISHED: White outlines vanished; podiums stayed fixed at R47/b47; gray 4x4 and cap positions unchanged; green token blocked when moving up while spark present. FAILED: Clicking podiums, red wire, cap, gray 4x4, yellow lamp, and green token produced no movement or state change. GOAL IS NOT: Moving the podiums, lighting the yellow lamp via current chain, or pushing the green token out of the socket. CONTROLS: Mouse clicks on objects registered as input but triggered no visible reaction or physics update.

GOAL: Guide the bubble to the pink cross. CONTROLS: Arrow keys dash the bubble across open space until it hits a wall or obstacle. RULE: Align the bubble’s center with the cross’s center for a successful match. TRAP: Assuming one dash covers the distance; the bubble stopped short, requiring a second left dash to finally reach the target.

ESTABLISHED: Stamping white from above turns the block all white. Loading purple works. FAILED: Moving the mold from above to below is blocked or ineffective. GOAL IS NOT: Leaving the block all white or all purple. CONTROLS: SPACE stamps color. Clicking slots loads color. Arrow keys rotate the mold, but some turns fail.

GOAL: Align two distinct shapes with their mirrored counterparts across a central axis. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the selected object or the axis; Space switched selection. RULE: Shapes matched only when their reflections landed precisely on the target outlines. TRAP: Assuming the axis was fixed; it required vertical repositioning to establish the correct mirror line.

ESTABLISHED: Rotation pivots around the green square’s center, not the plug’s own center. FAILED: Assuming rotation occurs around the plug’s bounding box or geometric center. GOAL IS NOT: A simple alignment of the plug’s center with the socket’s center. CONTROLS: SPACE rotates the plug 90 degrees clockwise around the green square’s coordinates.

GOAL: Slide the mold to the bottom slot to stamp the purple pattern. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the mold along the circular track; Space stamps the design. RULE: The mold orbits the block; only arrow keys matching the local track direction move it. TRAP: Pressing DOWN at the diagonal position fails; use RIGHT to continue the orbit to the bottom.

GOAL: Move four shapes to hide every colored dot. CONTROLS: Arrows steer the selected shape. Paints change color based on position. RULE: A shape must be the same color as the dots it covers. TRAP: Covering a dot with a mismatched color fails the level, even if all dots are technically hidden.

GOAL: Light both lamps simultaneously to extinguish the spark. CONTROLS: Arrows move the green token; clicks toggle the wire switch. RULE: Only one socket can be filled at a time, forcing a choice between lamps. TRAP: Believing the socket was a dead end; it actually allows pushing blocks through if wired correctly.

GOAL: Fill the grid’s diagonal split with three colors. CONTROLS: Arrow keys rotate the stamp; Space applies it. RULE: Each color paints a triangle defined by a sum of row and column indices. TRAP: Assuming stamps rotate instantly; you must reposition the mold to the correct orbit before painting.

GOAL: Align the black piece and horizontal line to cover all colored target cells exactly. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the selected object; Space cycles selection between the piece, vertical line, and horizontal line. RULE: The piece’s dots change color to match the cell underneath, confirming correct coverage. TRAP: Assuming Space cycles in a fixed order; instead, visually verify which object has white selection dots before moving.

GOAL: Stamp red, purple, and orange patterns onto the block using different mold orbits. CONTROLS: Click colors to load molds, arrow keys to rotate orbit position, SPACE to stamp. RULE: Each mold orientation stamps a unique shape, requiring precise rotation before pressing SPACE. TRAP: Batching multiple key presses blindly risks misalignment; verify the mold’s orbit position after each move to avoid wasted turns.

GOAL: Seat the cross in the left ring and park the block in the small ring's hole. CONTROLS: Arrows slide blocks until they hit an obstacle or edge; pushing a piece moves both together. RULE: Thin outlines do not stop sliding blocks, allowing long, uninterrupted moves across the board. TRAP: Assuming visual overlap blocks movement wastes turns; only solid objects halt the slide.

GOAL: Fill the grid by stamping colored blocks from orbiting molds. CONTROLS: Click colors to load, arrows to move orbits, Space to stamp, click molds to apply. RULE: Stamps only affect cells matching their specific geometric condition, like row or column limits. TRAP: Assuming diagonal positions show mold content; they are hidden, so verify orientation before stamping.

GOAL: Place four shapes into the target zone. CONTROLS: Arrows move the current shape; Space switches to the next shape. RULE: Every shape must land inside the marked area to win. TRAP: Assuming Space moves you; it only changes selection, wasting time if you try to move immediately after pressing it.

GOAL: Guide the green token from the red lamp to the yellow target. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the token; clicking the red podium rotates the wire layout. RULE: Wires form continuous vertical and horizontal paths; the token must stay on lit tracks. TRAP: Assuming the red podium’s rotation changes the pink wire’s path; it only affects the red section.

GOAL: Align the emitter to fire a beam through a gap, hitting a plug to unlock a path to the cup. CONTROLS: Arrows move the tip; clicking keypad cells sets the beam’s state to match the reference pattern. RULE: The beam only activates when the keypad configuration matches the visual reference exactly. TRAP: Firing before the keypad matches the reference wastes time, as the beam will fail to penetrate the plug.

GOAL: Guide the sky and pink dots to their matching red plus signs. CONTROLS: Click to move the selected head; the attached tail follows automatically. RULE: A dot completes the level only when it rests exactly on its corresponding plus. TRAP: The purple block is a solid wall, not a target, so don't try to push heads into it.

GOAL: Move three colored blocks to specific target corners. CONTROLS: Click buttons to rotate the board clockwise or swap two adjacent blocks. RULE: Rotations shift all blocks simultaneously; swaps only move the selected pair. TRAP: Assuming a block stays put when the board rotates; it moves with the frame.

GOAL: Paint four target shapes by stamping a rotating mold. CONTROLS: Arrow keys rotate the mold; Space stamps; clicks select colors or molds. RULE: Each orbit paints a specific geometric region, like triangles or half-planes. TRAP: Arrow keys move the mold along a circular orbit, not straight to the next position.
GOAL: Guide the beam to the cup. CONTROLS: Arrows move the tip; clicks fire the beam. RULE: The beam pierces gray paths to destroy plugs. TRAP: Moving right before clearing the plug wastes actions.

GOAL: Match the pattern in the box to the specific glyphs shown at the bottom. CONTROLS: Arrows move the cursor between boxes; Up and Down cycle the pattern inside the selected box. RULE: A box is solved only when its internal pattern exactly matches the target glyphs, including their specific orientation. TRAP: Assuming a wide box with two glyphs cycles them independently; it actually changes the entire pair simultaneously.

GOAL: Place both yellow blocks onto the cursor markers. CONTROLS: Rotate the red ring, rotate the green ring, and swap contents between the center and the outer ring. RULE: The shared cell forces the rings to move together, so you must park a block in the center to rotate the other ring independently. TRAP: Believing you must keep all blocks on the rings; leaving the center empty blocks you from separating the rotations.

GOAL: Arrange all pieces to align with hidden reflection axes. CONTROLS: Arrows move selected piece; Space cycles selection. RULE: Each piece mirrors across a specific line, requiring precise alignment. TRAP: Assuming pieces move independently; they must align with their respective reflection axes simultaneously.

GOAL: Slide to the exit in nineteen moves. CONTROLS: Arrows slide you until a wall or gray block stops you. RULE: Gray blocks are solid walls; you cannot pass through them. TRAP: Assuming a path is open because a block looks passable wastes turns; treat gray as hard barriers.

ESTABLISHED: Wires route automatically around obstacles, not in straight lines. The purple wire is too short. The green body does not overlap other elements. FAILED: Assuming wires are straight lines. Placing the green body without a land connection. Trying to force a wire across water when a land route exists. GOAL IS NOT: A simple straight-line connection between any two points. CONTROLS: Placing components defines endpoints. The system calculates the path. Water blocks routing unless at an island endpoint.

GOAL: Position the cross and green block to match the target layout using twenty-three moves. CONTROLS: Arrows move the selected block one step, or slide an adjacent block up to five steps without the pusher moving. RULE: A push sends the target block flying while the pusher stays exactly where it started. TRAP: Assuming the pusher follows the block into the new space wastes turns and breaks alignment.

GOAL: Expand colored bars to touch matching targets. CONTROLS: Click left tile to shrink, right tile to grow. RULE: Each bar grows only when its color matches the target. TRAP: Assuming symmetry; left and right tiles have opposite effects.

GOAL: Slide the green block right, then drop it through the ring to trigger the switch. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the block horizontally and vertically along the grid. RULE: Ring outlines are decorative; blocks pass directly through them without stopping. TRAP: Thinking the ring’s border was a solid wall that required navigating around the top edge.

GOAL: Place the green orb onto the purple lamp's core. CONTROLS: Arrows move the orb; clicks activate podiums. RULE: Two magenta cores act as linked portals, teleporting the orb between them instantly. TRAP: Assuming the orb must walk across the entire map, ignoring the magenta teleport shortcut to the lower island.

ESTABLISHED: Space converts the paddle's footprint into a permanent red bar, leaving a three-unit paddle at the right end. Visible red is the bar minus paddle-covered cells. FAILED: Assuming red cells vanish when the paddle passes over them, or that the bar size remains static regardless of paddle movement. GOAL IS NOT: A simple static barrier; the red bar interacts dynamically with paddle position to hide or reveal cells. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the paddle. Space triggers the conversion mechanic, creating the persistent red structure from the current paddle location.

GOAL: Clear the corridor by absorbing threats to reach the exit. CONTROLS: Arrows slide the player across ice until hitting a wall or enemy. RULE: Moving into an enemy cell absorbs it, removing the obstacle. TRAP: Assuming the enemy kills on contact; it actually disappears, allowing safe passage.

GOAL: Navigate the sprite to the dock while collecting both rings within the action limit. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the sprite in cardinal directions. RULE: Stepping onto the warp tile instantly teleported the sprite to a distant location, saving many moves. TRAP: Assuming the action bar only drained per move, not realizing a specific death action also consumed a turn, wasting time.

GOAL: Grow the band wide, slide it past the gray block, then lift it to cover four yellow dots. CONTROLS: Arrows moved the band. UP expanded width when blocked; RIGHT shifted position. RULE: The band widens only when moving up against the gray obstacle. TRAP: Assuming the band moves up normally while overlapping the gray block costs extra actions.

ESTABLISHED: The maze has four separate rooms connected by three narrow choke points. FAILED: Placing tokens directly on those choke points or their immediate exits. GOAL IS NOT: Simply blocking the narrowest passages to force a meeting. CONTROLS: Tokens block specific grid cells; blocks move through open cells.

ESTABLISHED: The camera shifts relative to the world even without vertical movement. FAILED: Moving right alone did not clear the level or prevent the camera drift. GOAL IS NOT: Simply reaching the right edge; the vertical alignment is the real puzzle. CONTROLS: Right moves the bubble horizontally; the camera follows, revealing new obstacles unexpectedly.

ESTABLISHED: Plugs are fixed obstacles; they never move. The key never gets carried by water. Current water levels prevent the key from swimming through the plug's gap. FAILED: Trying to align water levels to submerge the key for swimming. Attempting to use plugs as movable objects. GOAL IS NOT: Equalizing all water levels. Making the surface flat. Filling the yellow gap with water. CONTROLS: Water levels adjust in bands. Keys float at the surface. Plugs block flow but remain static.

ESTROLISHED: The plug slides until it hits a boundary, not the visible checkerboard edge. FAILED: Assuming the checkerboard pattern defines obstacles or that the field extends to the visible texture's edges. GOAL IS NOT: Moving the plug to the absolute left or right of the screen or through black cells. CONTROLS: Direction keys slide the plug until it stops at an invisible, tighter boundary than the texture suggests.

GOAL: Fit the wide plug into the right socket and lift it to the cup. CONTROLS: Plus toggles socket width; Y teleports plug to active socket; arrows move plug. RULE: Absorbing green batteries restores action points, allowing extra moves. TRAP: Assuming the socket width is fixed; it changes based on plug orientation.

ESTABLISHED: The maze has a long, forced detour from the upper corridor to the lower pocket. The path to the goal is significantly longer than a direct line, consuming most of the move budget. FAILED: Shortcuts through the center walls are blocked. Direct vertical descent is impossible due to a wall barrier. GOAL IS NOT: A simple reach-the-end task. The goal is not adjacent to the starting area, requiring a complex navigation loop. CONTROLS: Moves consume the budget. Pressing buttons resets or alters the ghost's position, but does not shorten the player's required travel distance.

ESTABLISHED: The robot requires box drop-offs in the central vertical lane to stay within time limits. FAILED: Dropping boxes in outer lanes or too early causes the robot to overshoot its deadline by seven seconds. GOAL IS NOT: A solo puzzle where only your own moves count against the timer. CONTROLS: Push boxes to the middle lane; wait for wall boxes to clear before placing yours there.

GOAL: Navigate the player to collect rings and cover a color-shifting object before delivering it to the goal. CONTROLS: Arrow keys moved the player; standing on an object toggled its color state. RULE: Sliding continued until a wall was hit, requiring precise stops to avoid overshooting targets. TRAP: Assuming the object’s color remained static wasted time; it changed upon every cover.

GOAL: Stall for ten moves to let a ghost travel its path, then walk to the exit. CONTROLS: Arrows move the player; oscillating between two squares wastes time safely. RULE: Ghosts follow fixed routes; once parked, they stay put forever. TRAP: Assuming ghosts remain active after finishing their path wastes time; they stop permanently.

ESTABLISHED: The plug sits permanently at the corridor's left end, blocking the lock's path to (7,0). The lock reaches (7,1) but cannot move further left. FAILED: Moving the lock to (7,1) did not push, move, or activate the plug. Clicking the plug had no effect. GOAL IS NOT: Simply positioning the lock adjacent to the plug or clicking it to "insert" it. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the lock along valid path cells; clicks on static objects do nothing.

GOAL: Move the yellow shape into the top-left target zone while avoiding the chasing socket. CONTROLS: Click a direction to move the shape diagonally or straight; the socket moves automatically each turn. RULE: The yellow shape moves faster than the socket, allowing you to outrun it if you keep distance. TRAP: Moving directly toward the target lets the socket intercept you; swing wide and loop around instead.

GOAL: Slide the plug so its tips sit precisely in the green tabs. CONTROLS: Arrow keys move the plug left or right; no rotation is needed. RULE: Only the horizontal orientation with prongs facing right allows the tips to dock. TRAP: Assuming the plug needs to physically touch the green block wastes time.

GOAL: Align blocks in correct order under the cable to clear the level. CONTROLS: Arrows move the claw; UP lowers the cable; LEFT/RIGHT push covered blocks. RULE: The cable only pushes blocks it has already covered, creating chain reactions. TRAP: Assuming the health bar drains per action; it actually depletes over time, so speed matters more than move count.
